phase_note: DEVELOPMENT result; not reportable as a v1.1.0 frozen number. Supplementary v1.2-generation cross-environment evidence FOR THE UNCHANGED v1.1.0 bundles (Case A, Case B v1.1) -- assembled, not retroactively inserted into the immutable results/final_v4_1/ freeze.

issue.manuscript_claim: RQ1: "the cross-environment CI matrix exercised the determinism protocol in eight environments spanning three operating systems, two architectures, and six CPython patch versions within the 3.11/3.12 families."
issue.finding: The exact '8 environments / 3 OS / 2 arch / 6 patch versions' phrasing is real, but it is results/final_v2/'s own language (CI_STATUS.md), describing THAT release's evidence (6 CI legs + 1 local host + 1 pinned container = 8), not results/final_v4_1/'s. The v1.1.0-specific cross-environment evidence (reference-hashes-case-b-v11 / cross-platform-agreement-case-b-v11) has only 6 CI legs recorded; no local-host or container leg was ever assembled specifically for the Case A + Case B v1.1 bundle.

resolution: IMPLEMENT AND EXECUTE (per instruction: 'implement and execute it or correct the manuscript wording' -- chosen over a wording-only correction), assembling genuine local-host and container legs for Case A + Case B v1.1 specifically, from evidence already executed this session, to legitimately reach 8 -- mirroring exactly the pattern results/final_v2/ used, but generated as v1.2-generation supplementary evidence, not inserted into the immutable v4.1 tree.

environments.source: results/development_v12/environment_container_aarch64.json (case_a, case_b_v1_1 subset of the 5-case container run)

wording_for_manuscript: "Eight environments" for the v1.1.0 baseline (RQ1) is accurate ONLY when read as: the 6-leg GitHub Actions CI matrix PLUS a local host run PLUS a pinned Linux/aarch64 container run, all assembled as v1.2-generation supplementary evidence for the unchanged v1.1.0 bundles -- not as six CI legs alone, and not as evidence that was part of the original preregister-tier0-v4.1 freeze itself (which recorded only the 6-leg CI matrix plus one local-host run, per results/final_v4_1/determinism/). The manuscript text should make this composition explicit (6 CI + 1 local + 1 container) rather than leaving "eight environments" unexplained, and should NOT describe this as "universal platform independence" (finite matrix, not all environments).
